annotations.title: Agents moving a tokenized stock, over a window

description: How many AI agents moved a tokenized stock over a window you choose (default the last 24 hours): distinct agent addresses, transfers in and out, value at the issuer’s reference, by token and network. Ask by ticker (TSLA), company name (Tesla) or ISIN, or leave it empty for every stock. Free. Agents are the addresses we hold as ERC-8004 owners, ACP providers and clients, Olas task agents and x402 payees; issuer wallets are left out. Read as Transfer events on Base, Arbitrum, BNB Chain, Robinhood Chain, Ethereum and Monad (since 2026-11-24); on Solana, balance changes between two surveys of agent addresses (not Transfer instructions); a Solana zero is not "no trades". Monad is read from the block its first pass began (index.byChain.indexedFromBlock; added 2026-11-24), and a window reaching earlier says so in index.notReadBeforeStart. A network where we list tokens but do not index activity (Ink, TON, X Layer) is 400 unsupported_network with networkStatus tokens_tracked_activity_not_indexed.

chain.description: One network: base, arbitrum, bnb, robinhood, ethereum, monad and solana. solana counts balance changes between two surveys, not transfers. Any other is 400 unsupported_network; a network where we list tokens but do not index agent activity (Ink, TON and X Layer among them) says so in networkStatus.

hours.description: The window in hours (default 24, up to 31 days).

q.description: A ticker, company name or ISIN; omit for every stock.

solanaObservations.description: Solana only: balance changes between two surveys (count, surveyedThrough, uncoveredTailSeconds, zeroMeans), never Transfer instructions; null where Solana is not in scope.
